name: Tyzon Swann
strengths: Swann gets off the ball with real first-step quickness for a 265-pound frame.
Swann shows functional strength to hold the point and still penetrate when he wins early.
Swann pursues down the line and does not quit when the play stretches.
weaknesses: Swann still needs consistency winning with hands/counters when OL sit on his first move.
comparison: Swann comps to Christian Wilkins — 6-3 disruptive DL with first-step quickness and functional strength to occupy gaps and push the pocket.
projection: Swann projects as develop into the DL room, earn early rotation snaps, then compete for a starting interior/edge-hybrid role — starter upside as a three-technique style disruptor with 5-star traits.
schemeFit: Swann fits White’s odd front as a disruptive interior who can two-gap or penetrate depending on call.
